description: Start (or stop) ongoing monitoring of a website's AI visibility on a schedule. Use this when someone wants to "monitor," "track," "watch," or "get alerted about" a site's AI visibility over time, rather than a one-off check. Adds weekly re-audits to the history that get_changes reads from — a history every audit already accrues, tracked or not — so use this to be watched on a schedule, not to make get_changes work. Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($10/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.
name: track_site

created.description: Present when starting: whether this call created a new tracking.

tracking.description: True after a start/confirm; false after a stop.

title: Start/stop monitoring
